config.single_variable: entry direction only: both, long-only, short-only; retain raw opposite exits and all original price paths
config.primary_tests: long-only and short-only vs same-direction matched random, each in earlier/later; Holm four tests; yearly rows descriptive
limitations: Already observed historical data; the short-side hypothesis was prompted by a later October forward snapshot.
Frozen 638-symbol Binance archive and tick sizes are not point-in-time metadata; not current OKX executions.
Replaying candidate admission reuses original per-candidate exits exactly; no capital or leverage portfolio model.
Control eligibility matches original summary, including exclusion of Sunday anchors; low matched coverage must be reported.

metric_scope: No classifier/ranking: AUC and top-decile metrics do not apply. Direction is the single-feature gate.
